tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Look up a single order (IDs look like ORD-10293). Gives back its status, line items, totals and delivery address.

tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: List the orders placed with a customer's email, newest first (up to 50). Use it when there is no order number.

status.description: Optional filter: pending, shipped, delivered or cancelled.

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Where a shipped order is now: carrier name, tracking number and the most recent delivery event.
